label: MORNING BRIEF

stories.title: Loan rates rise on 1 December
stories.story: Stanbic lifts its prime rate from 19.5% to 21.75%. DFCU and DTB go from 20% to 22%. Both changes start on 1 December.
stories.you: Buyers will qualify for less. Show cheaper homes to loan buyers.

stories.title: Costly plots push builders to flats
stories.story: Seven 50x100ft plots around Kampala were listed at Shs42m to Shs95m, a median of Shs85m. Builders are moving to flats.
stories.you: Pitch apartments to buyers priced out of plots.

stories.title: Give land free for 99.4km road
stories.story: Ministers asked Mitooma, Sheema and Rukungiri residents to give land freely for the 99.4km Kabwohe–Rukungiri road. Buildings in the road reserve won’t be paid for.
stories.you: Selling on the route? Check the road reserve before you list.

stories.title: Buganda wants its debt paid
stories.story: Buganda Kingdom asked government to clear what it still owes for properties confiscated decades ago, and to pay rent on time for facilities on kingdom land.
stories.you: Selling on kingdom land? Check the lease terms first.

stories.title: Museveni: keep family land whole
stories.story: Museveni told his family not to split the Rwakitura estate into plots after his death. They should keep it whole and share the income, he said.
stories.you: Selling family land? Get every heir’s consent in writing.
